title: Deep Q-network

paper.title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Deep Q-network: adapt replay and target-network temporal-difference learning to CartPole and evaluate independent episodes. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cartpole; required output: Observation -> action Q values. Evaluate episode_return (maximize). Replay target excludes true terminal bootstrap; distinguish truncation. Required ablation: Remove replay or the delayed target network separately. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
